rows.title: Aenigma Shards (AESH NFT cryptogram)

prize.note: promised across 10 contingent mint-count tiers; never materialized

rows.difficulty_note: A promised total is not a funded prize: mint stalled at 72 of 100, contract holds 0 ETH, no puzzle ever released beyond a demo. Check the contract balance, not the marketing.

rows.title: BAM x AskABitcoiner 42k Seed Cipher
rows.difficulty_note: Swept 2026-06-05 by another solver; passphrase was an artwork title. Reusable: this maker's series uses BIP49 m/49'/0'/0'/0/0 and a passphrase equal to an artwork title, not a block height.

rows.title: De Mint: Bitcoin Evangelism book puzzle

prize.note: puzzle 1; a later puzzle 2 of 1,000,000 sats had no published escrow

rows.difficulty_note: Puzzle 1 was cashed by a reader around October 2022 (author confirmed on camera); the escrow was never published. A podcast publish date is not an event date, and a coincidental amount match in a balance dump is not the escrow.

rows.title: The Game of Satoshi (Season 1)

prize.note: pool split among top 5000 players, paid by the organizer

rows.difficulty_note: Custodial: the 24 words are a game answer submitted to a server, not a mnemonic controlling a wallet. Ask first: custodial or permissionless? If the answer goes to a server, there is no key to derive.

rows.title: ncodemus: As Above, So Below (image treasure hunt)

prize.note: value at the sweep: 0.0617 ETH native plus 0.0617 WBTC held since 2021-08-01; about USD 1,800 when announced

rows.difficulty_note: Swept 2025-08-23 by an unknown solver, four years after publication; no write-up ever surfaced. Step one was gated behind an NFT purchase, so the public image alone was insufficient by design.

rows.title: Phemex Dorian Nakamoto 2.1 BTC puzzle

prize.note: on-chain portion; plus a 1 BTC off-chain exchange bonus

rows.difficulty_note: Swept 2020-03-21; the sweep transaction exposed the public key. The chain, not the press, is the source of truth: a 2024 article calling it unclaimed was wrong by four years.

rows.title: Wares Wallets (Solana video series)

prize.note: per puzzle; marketed higher than the real value

rows.difficulty_note: Checked escrows at 0 SOL; channel inactive since 2025-07-04. Reusable: Solana path m/44'/501'/0' (solana-cli/Solflare), not Phantom's .../0'/0'. Measure the real prize before the marketing number.

rows.title: ZK Guess #31 (chainhackers, Base)
rows.difficulty_note: Secret 149 was identified, but a third party guessed it about 40 hours later and the puzzle forfeited. A zero-cost, positive-value action runs immediately.
